thread:
maya: quick heads-up 1: I'm going to open a small refresh PR for the GreetKit quickstart. goals: switch auth examples to ephemeral token flow, add a single-file docker-compose first-deploy, and tighten model selection in snippets. will push a draft in ~30m. anyone want to sanity-check snippets?

jonah: I'll take auth checks tonight. which SDK version?

maya: targeting @redwood/inference v1.10.0 so we can use the auth helpers.

liz: link-checker already flagged an old env-var doc link in the current quickstart. docs-bot posted a report earlier.

docs-bot: automated-check: broken-link detected => https://old.docs.redwood.inference/auth/env-vars (404)

paul: For compose, prefer minimal: single node service mounting the repo, run npm install && start. avoids extra DB noise.

sam: on M1 we should recommend node:18-bullseye-slim or note the arm64 image requirement.

maya: good — plan: 1) replace bad link, 2) update SDK snippet to 1.10.0, 3) add minimal docker-compose, mac note, 4) add simple CI matrix (node 18 & 20), 5) explicit model in generate calls.

jonah: paste the signing snippet youre planning so I can confirm headers match runtime.

maya: draft snippet:

export RW_API_KEY=sk.test_XXXXX
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const token = await client.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttlSeconds: 300 });
// use token from client app for short-lived calls

liz: tiny nit 1: mention refresh before reuse and keep param name ttlSeconds.

paul: proposed docker-compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  greetkit:
    image: node:18-bullseye-slim
    working_dir: /app
    volumes:
      - ./:/app
    command: sh -c "npm install && npm run start"
    environment:
      - RW_API_KEY=${RW_API_KEY}

sam: add a troubleshooting note: if ECONNREFUSED, check RW_API_KEY is exported and not quoted in .env. I'll test compose on my M1 tonight.

maya: I'll also add a short migration callout: "If you used static keys in client examples before, migrate to ephemeral tokens or server-side signing to avoid leaking secrets."

jonah: also call out default-model change: older examples without model param might now pick 'gtr-mini-v1' 1. set model: 'rw/gtr-mini-v1' explicitly.

liz: I can do copy + link pass tomorrow morning (30 mins).

maya: awesome. allocating review owners in PR: liz (copy/links), jonah (auth headers), sam (M1 compose), paul (compose example). will tag you. docs-bot: remind CI linkcheck.
